description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, made of grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the great sawmill at its grandest: a tall mill house on a grey hewn stone base with a heavy timber upper floor and a wooden shingle roof, a big wooden water wheel with iron rims driving a frame saw that cuts a huge log, iron-banded piles of logs and tall neat stacks of pale yellow planks, a small timber crane

references.usage: the previous, third stage of this same building in the camp, chosen by the author: keep its idea, colours, outlines and pixel style, and draw its fourth, grandest stage, rebuilt for the stronghold with grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron
